title.zh: 沿着一条江，走过一个人的成长。
title.en: A childhood, a city, a river.

paragraphs.zh: 《小伢的江》是我们在 GGJ 2026 翌光计划武汉站共同完成的叙事交互游戏。我在活动现场组队并担任队长，组织沟通与协作，将武汉的城市记忆和一个普通小孩的成长连接起来。
paragraphs.en: We created Grow in Wuhan at GGJ 2026's Yiguang event in Wuhan. I formed the team on site and served as team lead, coordinating our work on a narrative connecting the city's memories with an ordinary child's life.

paragraphs.zh: 故事从二十年前的老窗出发，经过老街早餐摊、课桌与试卷、离乡的列车，再随返乡的高铁回望已经改变的故乡。童年、求学、离乡与返乡构成叙事主线。
paragraphs.en: The story begins at an old window twenty years ago, then passes breakfast stalls, school desks, examinations and a train leaving home. A high-speed train brings the protagonist back to a changed hometown. Childhood, school, departure and return form the narrative arc.

title.zh: 从情绪分区，到具体分镜。

paragraphs.zh: 我主导了游戏全部分镜策划，并参与故事设计，将成长经历落实为具体场景与画面顺序。分镜、故事与交互围绕同一条人生时间线展开，让玩家在日常片段中认识主角和这座城市。
paragraphs.en: I led all of the game's storyboarding and contributed to story design, organizing the protagonist's life into scenes and their visual sequence. Storyboards, narrative and interactions follow the same timeline through everyday moments.

paragraphs.zh: 分镜草稿用颜色区分“舒缓、欢快、忧伤、希望”四种情绪，并并列呈现镜头顺序与音乐基调。这份过程材料展示了画面编排背后的节奏设计。
paragraphs.en: The storyboard draft uses color to distinguish four moods: calm, cheerful, sorrowful and hopeful. Shot order and music cues are shown together, documenting the emotional pacing behind the visual sequence.

caption.zh: 情绪与音乐分区草稿 · 本人提供的分镜过程材料；主导全部分镜策划
caption.en: Emotional pacing and music-cue draft · Author-supplied process material; I led all storyboarding

title.zh: 交互即关卡，让日常动作推进故事。

paragraphs.zh: 我参与关卡和交互设计及关卡制作，以“交互即关卡”组织体验。拖拽拼图、早餐点击等操作承载故事推进；玩家通过具体动作参与场景，而不只是阅读介绍。
paragraphs.en: I contributed to level and interaction design and level production. Dragging puzzle pieces and clicking through breakfast turn familiar actions into ways of progressing through the story.

paragraphs.zh: 游戏选择轻操作、无失败惩罚的基调。我参与整体设计与基调敲定，让玩家可以慢慢看、轻轻动，把注意力留给场景、记忆与成长。
paragraphs.en: I also helped establish the game's overall direction and tone: light interaction without failure penalties, leaving players time to observe the scenes and follow the protagonist's growth.

paragraphs.zh: 27 格场景编排图进一步展示了故事与操作如何交错：09—11 格是出门过早、点餐与制作；16—19 格由课本题目衔接车站轨道谜题与上车；22—27 格以高铁返乡、拍照和擦拭照片回望武汉。图中呈现的是场景与交互编排，实际游玩以试玩版本为准。
paragraphs.en: The 27-panel sequence connects narrative and actions: panels 09–11 cover breakfast, ordering and preparation; 16–19 move from textbook questions to a rail puzzle and boarding; 22–27 return to Wuhan through a high-speed train journey, photography and wiping a photograph. This board documents the planned scene and interaction sequence; the playable build is the reference for implemented gameplay.

title.zh: 从现场组队，到共同完成作品。
title.en: From an on-site team to a shared game.

paragraphs.zh: 作为队长，我组织团队沟通和协作；在具体制作中，我主导全部分镜策划，参与故事、关卡、交互与整体游戏设计。程序、美术等团队成果不归为我的个人独立实现。
paragraphs.en: As team lead, I organized communication and collaboration. My production work covered all storyboarding and contributions to the story, levels, interactions and overall design. The team's programming and artwork are not presented as my individual work.

paragraphs.zh: 项目已提供在线试玩和实机演示。下方通过真实路演照片与风格化团队合影，分别展示线下分享和团队创作氛围；作品发布记录可通过页首 GGJ 作品页查看。
paragraphs.en: An online playable build and gameplay video are available. The event photograph documents our presentation, while the stylized team portrait conveys the collaborative setting. The GGJ link above leads to the publication record.
